jobs.title: Project setup: fctl package, serve, schema, safety
jobs.description: uv project and package layout, console script `fctl` (§3.0); `fctl serve [--port 4545]` on 127.0.0.1 (§7.2); data dir `FCTL_HOME` (default `~/.claude-factories`); full `schema.sql` from §5.1 applied at startup in WAL mode; base Jinja layout with vendored htmx and highlight.js; local-safety middleware (§4.5: Host check, `X-Requested-By: fctl` on mutating requests); `fctl` HTTP client in the stdlib-only CLI module that sends the header; `.gitignore`; pytest + TestClient wired to a temp `FCTL_HOME` and a fake `claude` on PATH.

jobs.title: Projects: connect, workspaces, factory state, page
jobs.description: `GET /api/workspaces`, `POST /api/projects/connect`, `GET /api/projects?path=` (§6.1); `fctl connect --workspace W [--test-cmd C]` collecting path, name, remote, and default branch, rerun updates, unknown workspace created, and the main repo resolved from inside a worktree via `--git-common-dir` (§3.1, §7.4 step 1); factory state none / uncommitted / ready from `git cat-file -e <default_branch>:.claude/skills/factory/SKILL.md` (§3.2 step 4); workspace page with project rows, `+ Workspace`, and moving a project to another workspace (§8 item 2).

jobs.title: Tasks API: CRUD, stage and status, events, task add
jobs.description: `GET /api/projects/{id}/tasks`, `POST /api/projects/{id}/tasks`, `GET /api/tasks/{id}`, `PATCH /api/tasks/{id}` for `spec_md`, `stage`, and `status`+`position` (§6.2); stage → status mapping with an `events` row on every change (§5.2, §7.5); a manual move clears stage and is refused with 409 while a run is active; new tasks go to the bottom of Backlog (§3.3); `fctl task add "title"` (§7.2).

jobs.title: Project board: columns, cards, drag and drop, new task
jobs.description: project board page (§8 item 3, §8.1): four columns with counts, cards with stage, chips per round, +/−, "waiting on you" and red escalated bar; native HTML5 drag and drop between columns and to reorder Backlog (PATCH); `+ New task` form with title and markdown description (§3.3); header with Code link, factory state, and a disabled Run next; htmx poll every 3 s; empty states.

jobs.title: Rounds: submit API, round files, fctl submit and diff
jobs.description: `POST /api/tasks/{id}/rounds` and task create with `submit` (§6.2, §6.3); round `trigger` initial / agent / human and `base_sha`; per-file split into `round_files` with change type, rename `old_path`, binary flag, and +/− counts; 413 over 5 MB; `fctl submit --new --title T` and `fctl submit <id>` with the temp-index capture of tracked and untracked files (§7.4); standalone submit lands in review · human_review (§5.2); `GET /api/tasks/{id}/rounds/{n|latest}/diff` and `fctl diff <id> [--round N]`.
